metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Bram Weatherturn
records.biography_en: In The Convenient Positions, Bram Weatherturn takes the role of opportunistic position switcher. “I have always stood whichever way this points.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny weather vane with two opposing arrows.

records.name: Mara Promisecoil
records.biography_en: In The Convenient Positions, Mara Promisecoil takes the role of promise maker. “There's room for one more promise.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small spring wound around a blank rolled ribbon.

records.name: Otto Middlemark
records.biography_en: In The Convenient Positions, Otto Middlemark takes the role of compromise broker. “It fits if neither side pulls.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two dissimilar puzzle halves joined by one conspicuous brass clip.

records.name: Ned Answerloop
records.biography_en: In The Convenient Positions, Ned Answerloop takes the role of question dodger. “Let me answer the question next to that one.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: a small coiled arrow that points back into itself.

records.name: Tess Rulefold
records.biography_en: In The Convenient Positions, Tess Rulefold takes the role of procedure loyalist. “The tab says when we can discuss the tab.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small folded rulebook with one long colored tab.

records.name: Gus Handclap
records.biography_en: In The Convenient Positions, Gus Handclap takes the role of professional applause starter. “I thought that was our cue.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small wooden clapper device held by its handle.
